WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(CAST(amount AS FLOAT)) as avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
account_region AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    aa.avg_amount,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM account_avg aa
  JOIN account a ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amount) as region_figure
  FROM account_region
  GROUP BY region
),
all_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_figure) as overall_avg
  FROM region_avg
)
SELECT 
  ar.region,
  ar.region_figure,
  ar.region_figure - aa.overall_avg as exceeds_avg,
  ar.region_figure / aa.overall_avg as ratio
FROM region_avg ar
CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
WHERE ar.region_figure > aa.overall_avg
ORDER BY ar.region
